name: newik1_last_pl_control_20260605_v2
notes: NewIK1 last PL control-point experiment. Feature mode last_control uses RRB_after_pl[45] + last PL control gR1[3] + last PL control pRB[15] = 63D. Three stages: GT/teacher-forced pretrain, PL streaming cache adaptation, final TC fine-tune. Upstream PL checkpoint is selected init36 processed RunD-style best_loss.pt. V2 rerun uses /home/lingfeng/.conda/envs/globalpose-gpu Python 3.10 and env lib path for carticulate/g2o.
